caption:
Art first.

A large painted portrait, a figure under a wide straw hat in red, ochre and stripes, is given a whole white wall beside the dining table. Upstairs, a red-and-white work answers the oak door. Everything around them stays quiet so that they can lead.

Villa — living and dining room, first-floor lounge.
